import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def probe(req,pol,expected):
    before=copy.deepcopy((req,pol))
    actual=evaluate(req,pol)
    assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
    assert (req,pol)==before

p={'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01,'km':1000},'unique':True}
probe({'rows':[]},p,{'ok':True,'records':[],'errors':[]})
probe({'rows':[{'id':'zero','amount':0},{'id':'far','amount':1.5,'unit':'km'}]},p,{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'zero','amount':0,'unit':'m'},{'id':'far','amount':1500.0,'unit':'m'}],'errors':[]})
probe({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':-1},{'id':'a','amount':2}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'duplicate'}]})
probe({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':1,'unit':'nope'},{'id':'a','amount':2}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'unit'},{'row':1,'cause':'duplicate'}]})
probe({'rows':[{'id':False,'amount':-1,'unit':'nope'}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'}]})
probe({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':False,'unit':'nope'},{'id':'y','amount':1,'unit':'nope'}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'unit'}]})
probe({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':1},{'id':'a','amount':2}]},{**p,'unique':False},{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':1,'unit':'m'},{'id':'a','amount':2,'unit':'m'}],'errors':[]})
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
print('independent boundary probes passed')
